name: ui_buttons
prompt:
Game UI button sheet in exactly the comic cardboard style of the reference UI kit: thick black ink outline, slight hand-drawn wobble, a small strip of grey duct tape on one corner, subtle darker bottom edge for depth. Exactly 6 separate BLANK buttons arranged in 3 rows of 2: row 1: a wide yellow (#F5BD37) rounded-rectangle button (about 3:1) and a wide blue (#4A92C6) button of the same shape; row 2: a wide grey-beige (#BBAE9C) disabled button and a wide red (#D9402B) button of the same shape; row 3: a round red bottle-cap close button with a white X, and a square yellow button. The flat inner area of every wide button must be a clean even colour without icons (text will be added later).
Flat front view, no perspective, no text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols inside the blank areas. Each item separate and fully visible with generous empty space between items. Solid flat pure green (#00FF00) chroma-key background everywhere, no shadows on the background, no scenery, no borders. Do not use any green colour in the items themselves.
